name: The Battle Plans
summary: You carry the Woodpaw battle plans toward Camp Mojache, where Hadoken Swiftstrider hopes to learn what the gnolls intend.

sections.title: Back to Camp Mojache
sections.body: After Woodpaw Investigation, you bring the Woodpaw battle plans back to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache. He needs firm evidence of what the gnolls intend.

sections.title: Hadoken's Reading
sections.body: Hadoken Swiftstrider says the plans are just what they needed. Most of the scrawl is beyond him, but he has read enough battle plans to see the gnolls fight on two fronts. One front is Camp Mojache. Most of their strength is turned against an enemy to the south. Hadoken senses something larger behind the fighting and believes they need to learn who that second enemy is.

faq.q: Where do these battle plans need to go?
aliases: where to turn in the battle plans
faq.answer: Take the plans to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache.
Woodpaw Investigation came before this, when you searched for the gnolls' plans.

faq.q: Where did the battle plans come from?
faq.answer: The plans belong to the gnolls. You found them in gnoll camps south of Camp Mojache during Woodpaw Investigation.
